newsitem.title: UK: Flemings signs advisory mandate with Kursk region.
newsitem.headline: Flemings signs advisory mandate with Kursk region.

text.p: Robert Fleming & Co Ltd signed an advisory mandate on Monday with the Kursk region of Russia to act as financial consultant for the region, Flemings and Kursk governor Alexander Rutskoi said at a joint press conference.

"Based on the governor's strong commitment to reform, we have signed an advisory mandate with the governor and the Kursk region," said Michael Hammond, head of European equity capital markets at Robert Fleming & Co Ltd in London.
"Flemings will be the financial consultant in the Kursk region," added Kursk governor Alexander Rutskoi.

Hammond said Flemings will use its knowledge in Russia and other emerging markets to leverage opportunities in various sectors including mining, banking, airport infrastructure, telecommunications and electric and water utilities.
